//: agent-memory hooks for Cursor (IDE + cursor-agent CLI). hooks/agent-memory/install.sh merges this into ~/.cursor/hooks.json after replacing __CURSOR_WRAPPERS__ with the absolute wrapper dir (~/.cursor/hooks/agent-memory). Commands are zero-argument executable wrappers because the IDE is not guaranteed to shell-process the command string. Cursor caveats: sessionStart does NOT re-fire on resume or after compaction (postToolUse re-injection covers both); beforeSubmitPrompt and stop do not fire in `cursor-agent -p` print mode; preCompact is observational only. sessionStart passes workspace_roots, not cwd.
